armor-of-shadows.name: Armor of Shadows
armor-of-shadows.description: Cast Mage Armor on yourself at will, without a spell slot.

eldritch-mind.name: Eldritch Mind
eldritch-mind.description: Advantage on Constitution saves to keep Concentration.

pact-of-the-blade.name: Pact of the Blade
pact-of-the-blade.description: Conjure a pact weapon; Charisma drives its attack and damage rolls.

pact-of-the-tome.name: Pact of the Tome
pact-of-the-tome.description: A Book of Shadows holds three cantrips and two level 1 rituals, always prepared.

agonizing-blast.name: Agonizing Blast
agonizing-blast.description: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of Eldritch Blast.

devils-sight.name: Devil's Sight
devils-sight.description: See normally in Dim Light and Darkness, magical or not.

fiendish-vigor.name: Fiendish Vigor
fiendish-vigor.description: Cast False Life on yourself at will, without a spell slot, for 12 Temporary Hit Points.

mask-of-many-faces.name: Mask of Many Faces
mask-of-many-faces.description: Cast Disguise Self at will, without a spell slot.

misty-visions.name: Misty Visions
misty-visions.description: Cast Silent Image at will, without a spell slot.

repelling-blast.name: Repelling Blast
repelling-blast.description: A hit with Eldritch Blast pushes a Large or smaller target away.

eldritch-smite.name: Eldritch Smite
eldritch-smite.description: Spend a Pact Magic slot on a pact weapon hit for extra Force damage; the target may fall Prone.

thirsting-blade.name: Thirsting Blade
thirsting-blade.description: Attack twice with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.
